name: Decimal numbers use locale-correct separators
description: Numbers must localize: English uses a dot decimal separator (2.45) while Spanish and Portuguese use a comma (2,45). A decimal value shown on a match page (odds or a percentage) must reflect the locale's separator. A build that prints raw English-formatted numbers in every locale fails this test.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the first match id
Navigate to /en/match/<captured-id>, open a tab showing a decimal value (odds or prediction percentage), and read the formatted number
Navigate to /es/match/<captured-id>, open the same tab, and read the corresponding decimal value

Verify the same decimal quantity renders with a dot separator on the English page (e.g. 2.45) and a comma separator on the Spanish page (e.g. 2,45). If both locales display the identical dot-formatted number, the test fails.
